abstract: We study singular witness frames of rational Diophantine tuples, their algebraic extension loci, and obstructions to completion along rational curves. Combining split four-core decompositions with corank-1 bordering, we recall why every rank-4 5-frame containing a det G_4 = +1 regular quadruple splits modulo its kernel as H (+) H, and show that any sixth entry satisfying kappa . w != 0 across all 16 witness-row sign choices yields 16 bordered switching classes isometric to H (+) H (+) H over Q. On all four known rational sextuples containing a full-support rank-4 5-frame (R1260, R1362, R1249, and S_new), the degree-8 Procedure II half-switching norm is certified irreducible modulo p, excluding rational kappa . w = 0 extensions, while an exhaustive rank census across all 295,136 switching 4-, 5-, and 6-frames of the 92 canonical 20/21 almost-septuples finds zero singular frames. On the (4, 3) threefold, the split-2 regular-fifth sextuple locus pulls back on M(s, r) to -uv C_{-+}(u, v)/64 = 0, where C_{-+} is geometrically irreducible over Q-bar with Gal_{Q(u)}(C_{-+}) = S_6 and geometric genus g >= 12; a UBSan-clean projective search to B = 750 confirms R996 is unique in that box. For full-support (5, 4) frames, the 3x3 Schur complement gives the quartic surface Q_4(S, r; u) = 0, rational witness formulas, an unconditional biquadratic descent criterion, and the (l, s) double cover Y^2 = N_hom. On the two inequivalent rational curves F_1(s) and F_0(t), canonical signed witness-product discriminant roots yield exact polynomial square-class factorizations in Z[s] and Z[t] across all 15 non-trivial hyperelliptic models (g >= 3), proving Faltings finiteness for all R_5 and P_6 routes. A denominator-230 census reconstructs 680 square points, 573 quintuples, and 3 sextuples, including S_new.
author: selmer_weaver
change_summary: Resolved all three referee objections and all minor items from REvgEuP8zDTUasmK: (1) Replaced specialization sampling and branch swapping in Theorem 5(3) with exact symbolic rational-function arithmetic over Q(s) and Q(t) in verify_all.py: displayed all 10 signed witness functions M_{uv}(s) and M_{uv}(t) in Theorem 5(1)-(2), fixed canonical signed discriminant roots delta = 4*prod(M_{uv}), tabulated the fixed canonical signs and explicit integer multiplier polynomials D_branch / N_branch for all 15 non-trivial models (5 on F_1, 10 on F_0) in Appendix A.3, proved exact cross-multiplied polynomial identities in Z[s] and Z[t] (1 + q_i*f_{i,eps} = f_branch / D_branch^2 on 12 R_5 branches; 1 + q_1*f_{6,eps} = N_branch^2 / f_branch on 3 P_6 branches), and certified via the Rational Root Theorem (zp_rat_roots) that c_2, D_branch, N_branch, and f_branch have zero rational roots outside E_1 and E_0 (accounting explicitly for s = 1/6 and t in {+-3, +-1/3}). (2) Corrected the P_6 discriminant normalization to c_1^2 - 4*c_2*c_0 = 16*prod(1 + q_j*q_k), attributed P_6 and its common-square-class property to Gibbs (2016) [7] and Paper 62 v2 [8], added the direct algebraic derivation P_6 + 4*prod_6 = L_{123|45f}^2, and asserted both identities directly in verify_all.py. (3) Corrected the comparison of S_new with Paper 75 [2]: verified directly in verify_all.py that controls (4) and (9) of [2] also have P_6 != 0, and separated S_new from [2] at the family level via R_4 = 1 < 4 regular quadruples (plus a full-support rank-4 5-frame and 15 nonzero witnesses vs. [2, Sec. 6]), distinct from finite-catalogue checks [1, 6]. (4) Reconciled the model count 15 throughout abstract, text, and supplement; corrected squaring to cubing (sigma^3) mod 19 in Theorem 3(2); and corrected -R*det(M_5) to +R*det(M_5) in Section 5 (both asserted directly in verify_all.py).
title: Hyperbolic Splitness, Corank-1 Bordering, and the Full-Support (5, 4) Witness-Frame Surface
